title: SB1851 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 16; Title 36; Title 37; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 49 and Title 65, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2026-01-21; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513074119 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB1851.pdf (LegiScan doc 3325788))
provenance.note: Draft as introduced; adopted amendments are not in the text read and could change it. Section 1 replaces 39-17-1307 (the carrying-with-intent and under-25 juvenile-adjudication possession offenses are not in the new text); section 3 deletes 39-17-1311 (weapons in parks and recreation areas). Sections 4-27, 32-35, 37-45 are cross-reference and conforming changes, omitted. Text names HB 1737 as twin; LegiScan lists SB 1851, copy dated 2026-01-21. operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1307, is amended by deleting the section and substituting:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm and: (A) Has been convicted of a felony crime of violence or an attempt to commit a felony crime of violence; (B) Has been convicted of a felony drug offense; (C) Has been convicted of a felony offense other than an offense under subdivision (a)(1)(A) or (a)(1)(B); (D) Has been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence as defined in 18 U.S.C. § 921, and is still subject to the disabilities of such a conviction; (E) Is prohibited from possessing a firearm under 18 U.S.C. § 922(g); or (F) Has been adjudicated as a mental defective, has been judicially committed to a mental institution pursuant to title 33, or had a court appoint a conservator for the person by reason of a mental defect.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (5) An offense under subdivisions (a)(1)(D)-(F) is a Class A misdemeanor.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (e) A person does not possess a firearm if the firearm is in a safe or similar container that is securely locked and to which the person does not have the combination, key, or other means of normal access.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1311): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1311, is amended by deleting the section.
SECTION 28 (TCA 39-17-1316): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1316, is amended by deleting subdivisions (a)(1)(A)(i) and (a)(1)(A)(v).
SECTION 29 (TCA 39-17-1351): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1351, is amended by deleting subdivisions (c)(11), (c)(18), and (c)(19).
SECTION 30 (TCA 39-17-1352): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1352, is amended by deleting subdivisions (a)(9) and (a)(11).
SECTION 31 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1313(a), is amended by deleting the phrase "a person who has a valid enhanced handgun carry permit or concealed handgun carry permit or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g) may," and substituting "a person who lawfully possesses a firearm may,".
SECTION 36 (TCA 37-1-190): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 37-1-190, is amended by deleting the section.
